name: Magma geode
description: a floating round lump of cooled black slag rock with a cracked shell, molten orange lava core glowing out through the cracks, two small angry glowing eyes in a crack, wisps of smoke

poses.stand: floating in the air, cracks glowing
poses.struck: cracking open, lava light blazing out of the split
poses.dead: split clean in two halves with molten light bursting out between them

idle.action: floats, bobbing slowly, its cracks pulsing with lava light

move.action: drifts forward to the right, rolling slowly in the air, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with plenty of empty space around it, the whole thing visible. One thing alone, nothing else: no body, no arms, no legs, no person. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is this thing. Show the exact same thing {action}. Keep everything about it the same as image 1: shape, colors, size and position in the frame and art style. {background}
